name: com.polyphase.build.target.webgpu
author: Justin Jaro
description: Adds a 'Web (WebGPU)' build target to the Polyphase editor. Compiles the engine + Runtime/Web into a single-threaded WebAssembly module with Emscripten, renders through a WebGPU backend (Dawn's emdawnwebgpu port, WGSL ubershaders), packages cooked content into a MEMFS preload bundle with file_packager.py, and serves the result locally for Build & Run. Requires a WebGPU-capable browser (Chrome/Edge 113+, Safari 18+, Firefox 141+). Output runs from any static host - no SharedArrayBuffer / COOP-COEP headers required.
